bullets.title: Strong Monday open
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,103 at 03:32 SAST, up about 0.8% from Friday's 4,070, with an Asian range of 4,053-4,113 (Kitco).

bullets.title: Dollar a bit softer
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 102.1, down about 0.2%, and the 10-year yield is near 4.88% (Trading Economics; exact time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hike odds still high
bullets.text: December Fed hike odds were near 78% after Friday's 165,000 payrolls beat (NordFX); today's figure is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: CPI is the test
bullets.text: October CPI lands Tuesday 15:30 SAST with a 0.3% headline forecast; soft helps gold, hot helps sellers (GoldStockCanada).

bullets.title: Big week behind
bullets.text: Gold rose about 5% last week (NordFX), but it still sits below its 50-day and 200-day averages (GoldStockCanada, CAD chart).

bullets.title: Hormuz risk lingers
bullets.text: An attack on a vessel near the Strait of Hormuz pushed Brent back toward 98 dollars late last week (NordFX); weekend news is UNVERIFIED.
